mermina.github.io/beyond-gdp-nordics
Data analysis · Sustainability · Research

Beyond GDP — Nordic wellbeing & footprint

My own research, as an interactive dashboard. Three “beyond-GDP” measures of wellbeing — HDI, the Social Progress Index and the SDG Index — set against the Ecological Footprint and Biocapacity accounts I compiled, for the five Nordic countries, 2000–2022. I built the SQL behind it: three MySQL databases joined, period means, Pearson correlations and decoupling trends — then disaggregated to indicator level to show what the flattering headline scores hide.

Built withMySQL, Python, R, JavaScript

About

Doing more with less — on purpose.

I'm Marina Ermina — a data analyst and sustainability researcher based in Reykjavík, now building automation, AI and web tools.

I came to it from a few directions — sustainability programmes, research, EU grant work, and years of teaching across three countries — and they all kept leading back to one question: how do we do more with less? That's the idea behind everything I build. Use fewer resources, then put what you save where it does the most good.

What matters most to me is the part that's easy to skip: I build the thing, then I do the research to make sure the claims behind it genuinely hold up. That rigour isn't an add-on — it's what my work is built on.

I also build fast, with AI-assisted development — it's how one person can ship this range of work, and it's the same principle as everything else here: more with less.

Languages: English · Íslenska · Русский · Polski
